summary: Defines schema models and data structures representing Python code elements, symbols, classes, functions, modules, dependencies, and analysis metadata.
responsibilities: Define schema models and data structures representing Python code structures, analysis elements, symbols, and metadata.
relationships: Defines schemas used to represent Python code elements such as classes, functions, methods, callables, modules, variables, and dependencies.
design_decisions: Defines schemas, typed dicts, and union types for representing Python code structure and analysis metadata.
